{{Top|leg}}
'''Group AA''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of three [[TIE/ad starfighter]]s that was transferred from the [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|''Ton-Falk''-class escort carrier]] ''[[Tropsobor]]'' to the [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Protector (Victory I-class)|''Protector'']] during the [[Sepan campaign]]. They were defended by [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] and several other [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] squadrons when [[Dimok (people)|Dimok]] and [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]] forces [[Raid on the Tropsobor|attacked]] them.
